newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips seen set to open mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips seen set to open mixed.

text.p: The Dow Jones Industrial Average was expected to open mixed on Monday, gleaning some support from higher futures and steadier bonds, traders said.
The Dow closed 247 points lower on Friday at 7695, losing three percent of its value after the dollar slid and fears rose over future blue chip earnings.
On Monday the long bond was up 2/32 to yield 6.54 percent. S&P 500 futures built on earlier gains and were up 4.65 points at 903.45.
It was unclear if below-expectation earnings announced by Hewlett-Packard on Monday would have much general market fallout, traders added.
